crabs text index | photo index Phylum Arthropoda

Subphylum Crustacea > Class Malacostraca > Order Decapoda Brachyurans > Family Xanthidae Ruby reef crab
Actaea sp.
Family Xanthidaeupdated Dec 2019

Where seen? This tiny jewel of a crab was seen once on Labrador.

Features: Body width 1-2cm. Body and claws bright red with bumps and ridges. Like other brightly coloured Xanthid crabs, it is probably poisonous.


Labrador, Jul 05
